agent_explanation: From rest at step 0, one leapfrog step gives unequal-opposite kicks: light body dv~0.0574, heavy body dv~0.00295 (ratio ~19.5 vs mass ratio 17.5), leaving net momentum (0.00077,0.00569) and angular momentum 0.0416. Pairwise forces are not equal-and-opposite (e.g. sequential in-place evaluation using already-moved positions or mass-dependent force error), so Newton's 3rd law is violated and total momentum drifts. Equalizing masses removes the violation.
